title: Blocking Amalgamations, Maximal Arcs, and Generalized Crowns
summary: Let $C^r_{1,k}$ be the $r$-uniform $k$-crown and put $h=r-k+2$. For a finite linear intersecting $r$-uniform hypergraph $G$, let $τ_h(G)$ be the minimum size of a set meeting every edge of $G$ in at least $h$ vertices, and define \[ ρ_{r,k}=\sup_G\frac{|E(G)|}{τ_h(G)}. \] We prove that every fixed pair $(G,B)$, with $B$ an $h$-fold transversal, yields \[ \operatorname{ex}^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,C^r_{1,k}) \ge \frac{|E(G)|}{|B|}n-O_{G,B}(\sqrt n) \] for all sufficiently large $n$.
